# Trainyard

> Open-source (Apache-2.0) planning rooms for scaled agile: PI planning boards, program board, ROAM, confidence vote, retrospectives and dashboards that sync two ways with Jira and Azure DevOps, every scaling model (SAFe Essential/Portfolio/Full, AI-Native SAFe, LeSS, Scrum@Scale, Nexus, Flight Levels, tribes) as editable configuration, an AI-native portfolio module with stage gates, EU AI Act risk tiers and an agent registry, and import of existing boards from iObeya, Miro, Mural, monday.com, Trello, CSV and JSON.

Trainyard is self-hosted with Docker Compose and runs beside other sites on the same server behind Traefik. One edition includes every module. AI assistance works with Claude (Anthropic API key), any OpenAI-compatible server, or a local Ollama model; every AI answer is schema-validated and is a draft a person accepts.

## What it does

- PI planning: built-in boards sized to the workspace's teams and iterations; drag cards between iterations, draw dependencies, vote confidence, ROAM risks, run Inspect & Adapt.
- Tracker sync: features, stories, risks and dependencies pulled from Jira and Azure DevOps; moves on the board pushed back through an inspectable queue; webhooks and scheduled sync.
- Operating models: work levels, cadences, events, roles and metrics are data; fork a template and rename things to match your organisation.
- Lean portfolio: epics with WSJF, budgets and guardrails, OKRs.
- AI portfolio: initiatives and platforms with lifecycle stages, gates with evidence and evaluations, EU AI Act risk tiers, agents with autonomy levels 0 to 4, value-architect sign-off, audit log.
- Reporting: metric catalogue (flow, planning, portfolio, AI) and dashboards you compose; AI-written narrative on request.
- Bring your own boards: iObeya board exports (program, team, Kanban, roadmap and free boards with charts, images and dependencies), Miro REST v2, Mural, monday.com GraphQL, Trello, CSV, JSON; boards kept as imported, saved as templates, mapped onto the plan on demand.
- Security: API keys hashed at rest, roles (admin, planner, architect, viewer), rate limits, sign-in lockout, strict Content Security Policy, encrypted connection tokens, append-only audit.

## Comparable products

Capabilities from a side-by-side evaluation of PI planning dashboard tools (products change; check each vendor):

- iObeya: on premises or separate server; integrated web interface; ART board, ROAM, WSJF, retrospectives; portfolio and more; integration through API and iFrame.
- Easy Agile: Jira plugin; ART and team boards; Jira only.
- Agile Hive: Jira plugin; ART board, ROAM, WSJF, team execution; portfolio Kanban, roadmap, reporting; Jira only.
- BigPicture: Jira plugin; ART board, ROAM, WSJF, team execution; project planning and reporting with OKR and risk widgets; Jira only.
- PIPlanning.io: on premises or separate server; ART and ROAM boards; Jira.
- Miro: public cloud; PI planning templates, not integrated; limited ART board; no planning-data integration.
- Trainyard: open source and self-hosted, also a Jira app (Forge) and an Azure DevOps extension; PI planning, ART and team boards, ROAM, WSJF; portfolio Kanban, roadmaps, SAFe canvases, value stream identification and mapping, AI portfolio; two-way Jira and Azure DevOps; imports boards from iObeya, Miro, Mural and monday.com.

## Pricing

Practice: free. Self-host the whole product (Apache-2.0) with no limits, or one hosted room of up to 5 people; paid plans from the sixth person.
Trainer: $19 per trainer per month ($16 billed yearly). Unlimited participants, Jira and Azure DevOps sync, AI co-trainer with your own key, board imports, email support.
Academy: $249 per Agile Release Train per month ($199 billed yearly). Unlimited people per train, Jira app and Azure DevOps extension, SSO and audit trail, hosted or on your servers, named success lead. More than ten trains, on-premises support agreements: quote.
Prices in USD before tax. The unit is the trainer or the train, never the person in the room.
